units.source_text: 岳母常常对妻子说些对我不满的话，妻子都没有告诉我。

en.t: My mother-in-law often said things to my wife that showed her dissatisfaction with me, but my wife never told me about them.

units.source_text: 但是，妻子也觉得不说我几句，自己便受不了似的。

en.t: Even so, my wife seemed unable to bear it unless she said a few words of reproach to me herself.

units.source_text: 说是责备，语气并不严厉，所以无论妻子说我什么，我都没有生气过。

en.t: Though I call it reproach, her tone was never harsh, so whatever she said to me, I never became angry.

units.source_text: 她常常恳求我，有什么不顺心就痛痛快快地告诉她。

en.t: She often begged me to tell her frankly if anything was troubling me.

units.source_text: 她还劝我，为了自己的前途，赶快把酒戒了。

en.t: She also urged me, for the sake of my own future, to give up drinking at once.

units.source_text: 有时还哭哭啼啼地说：‘你最近好像变了个人。’

en.t: At times she would even say through tears, 'Lately you seem like a completely different person.'

units.source_text: 如果只说这些倒也罢了，她还说：‘倘若K活着，你也不会变成这样子的吧。’

en.t: If that had been all, it would have been tolerable, but she also said, 'If K were alive, you probably would not have become like this.'

units.source_text: 然而，我回答的意思同她理解的意思完全不同，因此我心里愈发悲伤。

en.t: Yet the meaning of my answer was entirely different from the meaning she understood, and so I felt even sadder inside.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，我仍然不想对妻子作任何解释。

en.t: Even so, I still had no wish to explain anything to my wife.
I often apologized to my wife,

units.source_text: 大多是喝醉了，很晚回家的次日早上，

en.t: usually on the morning after I had come home very late, drunk,

units.source_text: 妻子有时只是笑笑，有时默默不语，也有时眼泪涟涟。

en.t: Sometimes my wife merely smiled, sometimes she said nothing, and sometimes tears streamed down her face.

units.source_text: 无论妻子是什么反应，我都非常痛苦，

en.t: Whatever her reaction was, I suffered deeply,

units.source_text: 所以我向她认错，即是向自己认错。

en.t: so apologizing to her was, in effect, apologizing to myself.
In the end, I did give up drinking,

units.source_text: 与其说是由于听了妻子的劝，不如说是自己感到厌恶更恰当。

en.t: but it would be more accurate to say that I quit because I had grown disgusted with myself than because I listened to my wife's advice.
